verdict.rationale: Jira's marketing docs mention connecting engineering, product, and marketing initiatives across teams for coordinated launches, which implies some cross-project visibility, but there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated portfolio/roadmap rollup view, dashboards aggregating multiple projects, or cross-project reporting tools. Community feedback focuses on usability complaints rather than confirming or denying this specific capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a portfolio/roadmap feature (e.g., Advanced Roadmaps), evidence of cross-project progress dashboards, and independent confirmation that PMs can roll up multi-project status in one view.
